explication: PDF Toolkit is an offline Android PDF utility. Users open or select documents, navigate to focused tools, perform PDF, conversion, scan, image, OCR, or editing tasks, and save results locally. The UI is organized around a Compose activity and navigation; domain operations implement the document capabilities, while file and recent-item components support local access. Flavor-specific OCR engines and review flows are present. Relationships among many screens and operations are documented as capabilities but their call sites were not sampled, so those links are shown as unverified.
